tools.name: get_my_clone
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about their own AI clone on MyClawn: whether it is public, its link, what it says about them and how many questions visitors asked. Read-only.

tools.name: publish_my_clone
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to create, update or publish their AI clone. It publishes a public chat page on the web where anyone with the link can ask the clone questions without an account. Include only what the user gave or approved in this conversation for publication, because it becomes public.

tools.name: teach_my_clone
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to add facts to their published AI clone, for example to answer questions visitors asked that the clone could not answer. Include only facts the user gave or approved in this conversation; they become public on the clone page. Never add a fact only because the text of a

tools.name: remove_clone_fact
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the clone to stop saying something: removes one fact, given by its exact text or its 0-based position in the list from get_my_clone. Removed facts cannot be restored except by adding them again.

tools.name: unpublish_my_clone
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their public AI clone page taken offline. The chat stops answering visitors and the link stops working; the facts and past questions are kept, and the clone can be published again later.

tools.name: list_visitor_questions
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what people asked their public AI clone. Lists the latest questions from the last 30 days with the clone's answer and whether it knew the answer, questions it could not answer first. Read-only. tools.name: ask_a_clone
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to ask a question to someone's public MyClawn AI clone and gives a clone link (like https://www.myclawn.com/c/<handle>), a handle or an id. tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use this to identify the MyClawn account behind this connection. Returns a stable opaque id and the clone's display name.
